summary: 37-year-old climber from Arizona fell 100 feet on the upper Ruper route, Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park, ~1:10 p.m.; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group rappelled from above to reach the climber on the upper ramp, lowered him to the lower ramp, then scree-evacuated him to the trail and a waiting ambulance; transported to Boulder Community Hospital. ~7.5-hour rescue.
location: upper Ruper route, Red Garden Wall, Eldorado Canyon State Park
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Mountain View Fire Protection District
notes: BCSO case 22-3562. Distinct from the dateless Boulder Weekly "Climbers rescued" Red Garden Wall lead (March 4, year unknown) — that lead stays pending.
